zh.title: 民航局協調增開第二波離島加班機20架次 11月24日上午9時開放訂位
zh.summary: 民航局協調選舉期間第二波離島加班機20架次，11月24日上午9時開放訂位。
body: 交通部民用航空局表示，為因應地方公職人員選舉期間返鄉投票需求，已協調航空公司在運能許可下增開第二波離島航線加班機。這波加班機包含放大機型，共20架次、提供1,884個座位，將於11月24日上午9時開放訂位。
這批加班機提供的座位中，澎湖航線與金門航線各有872個，馬祖航線有140個。民航局表示，此前已為選舉旅運需求協調航班及規劃加班機，總計提供7.1萬個座位。
民航局提醒，選舉期間離島航線部分尖峯日期及時段的機位需求較高；若未能訂到首選航班，可考慮其他日期或離峯時段的班次。

en.title: Taiwan CAA plans second wave of extra island flights; bookings open Nov. 24
en.summary: Taiwan CAA plans 20 island flight services for election travel; bookings open Nov. 24 at 9 a.m.
body: Taiwan’s Civil Aeronautics Administration (CAA) said it has coordinated with airlines, within available capacity, to offer a second wave of extra services on offshore island routes for people traveling home to vote in local elections. The plan covers 20 flight services, including flights using larger aircraft, with 1,884 seats. Reservations open at 9 a.m. on Nov. 24.

Of the seats offered in the plan, 872 are on Penghu routes, 872 on Kinmen routes and 140 on Matsu routes. The CAA said it had previously coordinated flights and planned extra services providing 71,000 seats for election-related travel.
The agency said demand is higher on some peak dates and at peak times. Passengers unable to book their preferred flights can consider other dates or off-peak services.
